subject: Synthesis: brief RCA, evidence package, and customer verification steps
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@finexco.com>, support@finexco.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Synthesis: brief RCA, evidence package, and customer verification steps

Hi Dana / Finexco team,

Thanks again for your patience this morning. I wanted to send a concise synthesis of our findings and the concrete next steps from Redwood following the availability incident you observed on 2027-12-18. Attached is a short RCA annex and an evidence export. The email below contains the key timeline, root cause in plain language, and the actions we will take to verify mitigation.

High-level summary (TL;DR)
- What happened: a cascading resource-starvation event in a shared scheduling path caused a subset of inference requests for your org to observe 5-15s token delays and intermittent 503s for ~27 minutes.
- Root cause (short): an inefficient eviction interaction between our KV-cache refactor and an edge batch-splitter which, under a specific concurrency pattern, triggered excessive GPU memory churn.
- Impact window: 2027-12-18T22:14Z to 2027-12-18T22:41Z (27 minutes).
- Customer impact: increased per-request latency, ~0.2% request error rate spike for Finexco's primary route; no data exfiltration.

Attachments included: 20271219-rca-annex.pdf (two-page executive RCA), evidence-log-20271219.csv (request-level events), fix-patch-3124.tar.gz (candidate runtime patch).

Action items (what Redwood will do and timeline)
1) Confirmed patch build and staged rollout (Marissa) — patch build completed, will deploy to Dedicated canary within 24h, broader rollout in 72h if metrics confirm.
2) Permanent fix and kernel selection guardrails (Grace) — target release in v1.12.2 (estimated 3 weeks).
3) Verification test plan for Finexco traffic pattern (Rafael) — run bespoke canary against a traffic replay you approve; results shared and a play-by-play verification checklist provided.
4) Customer credit offer and closure package (Rafael/Finance) — DocuSign link below for the agreed service credit once you confirm the verification steps.

Immediate ask from us: please confirm a 30-minute window in the next 48 hours when we can run a controlled replay against a staging endpoint (we will not use production tokens) so we can demonstrate the patch addresses the specific concurrency pattern.

We will follow up with a short verification run report and the playbook for on-going monitoring. If you prefer a quick call, I can be available this afternoon PST.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Attachments: 20271219-rca-annex.pdf (pdf), evidence-log-20271219.csv (csv), fix-patch-3124.tar.gz (tar.gz)

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@finexco.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@finexco.com
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Synthesis: brief RCA, evidence package, and customer verification steps

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the quick synthesis and the annex. A couple quick clarifications before we lock times: 1) the impact window you list matches our logs but can you confirm whether any retry logic on our side could have amplified the load during 22:20-22:30Z? 2) Are there any customer-side configuration changes we need to do for the verification replay (e.g., headers, client-side batching)?

If you're proposing to use a replay, we prefer it outside of our business hours (UTC evening is OK). We can provision a short staging token if you provide the scope.

Thanks,
Dana Liu
Director of AI Ops, Finexco
Dana.Liu@finexco.com

On Sun, Dec 19, 2027 at 09:12 Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@finexco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Synthesis: brief RCA, evidence package, and customer verification steps

Hi Dana — good questions. Short answers below and a proposed verification window.

1) Retries: we reviewed the request traces in the attached evidence export; Finexco's client-side retry policy did not materially amplify the concurrency pattern. The headroom exhaustion was driven primarily by internal batching behavior when a specific set of large-sequence requests coincided with an edge split that forced memory rematerialization. We detail this in the annex (section 2.3) with example trace ids.

2) Replay config: we only need a staging API key scoped to the same route and the same per-request headers. No config changes required on your side; we will emulate the original per-request size and timing. We will share the specific replay configuration and the script once you confirm the window.

Proposed verification window: Mon 2027-12-20, 02:00-02:30 UTC (evening your time). This avoids business-hours impact and gives our engineering team time to validate the canary. Could you confirm if this works?

Next steps after your confirm:
- Run the replay against the canary for 20-25 mins, capture relevant metrics, and share the canary vs baseline traces.
- If OK, we will schedule the controlled Dedicated rollout and provide the post-rollout verification report.

Best,
Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Liu <dana.liu@finexco.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 02:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Synthesis: brief RCA, evidence package, and customer verification steps

On behalf of runtime, quick operational note: the fix-patch-3124 includes a lightweight guard that forces an alternate KV-eviction path when concurrent-large-sequence patterns are detected. Canary build has been smoke-tested internally against synthetic traffic that mirrors Finexco's median sequence lengths. We will deploy the canary to the Dedicated pool scoped to Finexco routes at 02:00 UTC and run the replay. Ops will monitor GPU memory churn and request latencies live.

There will be minimal config drift — the patch does not require client-side changes. We have the rollback plan ready (immediate traffic switch to previous kernel and a preserved snapshot of state).

Marissa
Staff Software Engineer, Runtime
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@finexco.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Synthesis: brief RCA, evidence package, and customer verification steps

Confirmed for the proposed window — Mon 2027-12-20 02:00 UTC works for us. We'll provision a staging token scoped to the primary route and drop it into the secure link you provided. Please share the replay script and the verification checklist ahead of the run; we'd like to have our on-call observe the metrics.

Happy to proceed with the DocuSign credit offer after verification. Thank you for the clear package and the proactive mitigation plan — we'll watch the run and report back.

Dana
